verdict.rationale: Make is an automation platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no sandbox, staging, or isolated test environment, and no dry-run mode. Cloning a scenario and viewing scenario history are adjacent features that a user might use as a workaround, but they do not isolate tests from production data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
